central_main_stem.description: The primary vertical stem of the plant, rendered in green with prominent red central vein/stripe. Runs from the root cluster at the bottom of the page to the apex flower head. This stem is the primary bisecting agent for lines f2r.1 through f2r.12, physically interrupting the text flow in each of those lines.

left_secondary_stem.description: A secondary stem branching left-upward from the main stem at approximately y=380, rendered with red vein, terminating in the left flower head. Bisects upper text lines (f2r.1–f2r.6) together with the main stem, creating additional left-side gaps.

right_secondary_stem.description: A secondary stem branching right-upward from the main stem at approximately y=300, rendered with red vein, terminating in the right flower head. Also bisects upper text lines on the right side.

flower_head_center_top.description: Large thistle-like composite flower head at the apex of the central stem. Consists of a dense mass of fine radiating filaments forming a rounded-oval crown. Pale buff/cream color with fine brown ink detailing. This flower head intrudes into the top text margin, causing the upper text to arch around it.

flower_head_left.description: Medium-sized thistle-like flower head on the left secondary stem. Similar filament structure to the central flower. Positioned in the upper-left quadrant of the illustration zone. Partially overlaps left-side text columns.

flower_head_right.description: Medium-sized thistle-like flower head on the right secondary stem. Positioned in the upper-right quadrant. Partially overlaps right-side text columns.

leaf_cluster_upper_left.description: Large compound pinnate leaf group radiating upper-left from the main stem junction near y=380. Multiple elongated serrated leaves in deep green, painted with gestural brushwork. Leaves extend significantly into the left text column zone.

leaf_cluster_upper_right.description: Large compound pinnate leaf group radiating upper-right from the right stem junction near y=330. Mirror of the left cluster. Extends into the right text column zone of both upper and lower text blocks.

leaf_cluster_lower_left.description: Secondary compound leaf group radiating lower-left from the main stem at approximately y=560. Partially overlaps the lower paragraph text block on the left side.

leaf_cluster_lower_right.description: Secondary compound leaf group radiating lower-right from the main stem at approximately y=540. Overlaps the lower paragraph text block on the right side.

green_wash_circle.description: A large circular area of flat translucent green watercolor wash applied behind the middle section of the plant illustration. Serves as a background field for the central stem, upper leaf clusters, and surrounding text. Diameter approximately 380 normalized units, centered near the mid-page.

root_system.description: A complex dark reddish-brown curling tuberous root mass at the base of the main stem. Consists of multiple thick sinuous root branches curling outward and downward, with tapering terminals. Occupies the lower-center of the parchment below the text blocks.

stem_buds_red_dots.description: Small red painted dot ornaments appearing at stem branch junctions, approximately 3 instances visible along the upper branching stems. Likely represent buds or stylized calyx nodes.

text_blocks_mapping.description: The primary text block of f2r, occupying the upper portion of the parchment above and around the upper plant illustration. Runs from the top margin downward, flanking and being repeatedly bisected by the central main stem and the two secondary stems. Lines f2r.1 through f2r.7 belong here. Due to the three diverging stems (central, left-secondary, right-secondary), many lines exhibit two or three <-> bisections, creating three or four text segments per line.

The left flower head occupies the upper-left zone at this y-level and constrains the left text margin to begin no further left than ~x:115.

The flower head itself is completely text-free internally; the surrounding text conforms to its circular profile, with left-side text segments not exceeding x_max:~380 and right-side segments not starting below x_min:~560 at the relevant y-levels.

The upper-left quadrant of the page has a clear text-free zone corresponding to this flower head's footprint.

isolated_zones.status: Partially text-free / Right text margin constrained by presence
isolated_zones.description: The right flower head (x:640–770, y:100–240) mirrors the left flower head's effect on the opposite margin. Right-side text segments of bisected lines f2r.1–f2r.4 are bounded at approximately x_max:760 to avoid the flower, creating a text-free zone within x:640–770, y:100–240.

isolated_zones.status: Intentionally bisected — primary bisecting axis of the entire folio
isolated_zones.description: The central main stem is the dominant structural feature of f2r's text layout. Its vertical extent (x:430–510, y:90–870) creates a persistent gap in every line of both text blocks. In the upper block it cooperates with two secondary stems to create 2–3 bisections per line (f2r.1–f2r.6). In the lower block it alone bisects each line (f2r.8–f2r.12), splitting the lower paragraph into a clear two-column arrangement flanking the stem. The negative space within the stem band is consistently ~70–80 normalized units wide.

The large circular green wash (x:200–730, y:300–750) functions as the illustration field background. No text loci fall within the core of this zone. The text blocks terminate above (upper paragraph ends ~y:400) and resume below (lower paragraph begins ~y:790) this zone, leaving the entire green-wash area as pure negative space occupied only by leaves and stem.

isolated_zones.status: Completely text-free internally / Surrounded by label
isolated_zones.description: The root system (x:290–640, y:870–1000) is text-free in its interior. It sits below both paragraph blocks and is associated only with the isolated @Lp label (f2r.14: 'ytoail') which annotates it from the lower-left margin. The curling root forms an intentional visual terminus for the plant illustration with no text overlapping its forms.

isolated_zones.status: Completely text-free internally / Flanked by bisected text segments
isolated_zones.description: The large upper-left leaf cluster (x:110–460, y:320–560) occupies the left-center illustration zone. No paragraph text overlaps with the leaf forms themselves. The bisected text segments to the left of the central stem terminating at x_max:~420 in lines f2r.5–f2r.7 run above this cluster's y_min.

isolated_zones.status: Completely text-free internally / Associated with @L0 label (f2r.15)
